llm_summary:
The six-round campaign is complete and the full budget was spent. In the final round I used `exploit_ratio=0.95`, satisfying the final-round exploitation requirement; although the campaign was stalled, exploitation was prioritized for the final harvest because there was no later round to recover exploratory discoveries. No motif exclusions were applied because the negative results were primarily context-dependent multi-mutation failures rather than proven single-motif lethality.

The global best remained:

`DEEEIRTTNPVATEQYGSYSTNLQQGNR` — `9.536`

The final batch did not improve it. Its strongest results were:

- `DEEEIRTTNPVSTEQYGEVSTNLQRGGR` — `6.853`
- `SEEEIRTTNPTATEQYGEVSTNLQRGNR` — `6.688`
- `SEEELRTTNPVSTEQYGSVSTNLQRGNL` — `6.481`
- `DEQEIRTTNPVATEQWGSVSTNLQRGNM` — `4.885`
